description:
G’day ya LEGEND 🤙
I’m David List — tradie-turned-creator, automation nerd, and the bloke behind Trade Magnet.

This channel is where trades, tech, and fun collide.
I make videos that help Aussie tradies work smarter, win more jobs, and automate the boring sh*t, using tools like ServiceM8, Simpro, AroFlo, GoHighLevel, n8n, and proper systems that actually fit how tradies work.

But don’t worry — it’s not all serious business.
You’ll still see:
⚡ Electrician Reacts
⚡ Trade stories & breakdowns
⚡ Behind-the-scenes content
⚡ Random fun stuff I get up to

And alongside that, you’ll get:
🔧 ServiceM8 tutorials & full setup guides
🔧 Trade automation walkthroughs
🔧 Tips to streamline scheduling, quoting & invoicing
🔧 Tech, tools & workflow hacks for your trade business

If that sounds like your vibe…
🔴 SMASH that SUBSCRIBE button
